survey.title: Tucson City Council Proposed New Law on Smoking in Restaurants
survey.description: We need your opinion on a proposed new city ordinance with a fine to seek social courtesy and good smoking manners in Tucson restaurants.

questions.question: Do we need a new city ordinance enforceable with a fine to seek social courtesy and good smoking manners?
Is it best to source personal courtesy and thoughtfulness among the customers in Tucson without the sanction of further laws and prosecution?
Have you personally experienced any discomfort by the smoking public in this establishment?

additional_info.instructions: Please present this to the cashier or leave it at your table. Thank you for being of assistance to us in our survey.
additional_info.note: We need more cards filled out for a broad consensus and for final report to City Council. Total replies as of September 19, 1977: 50000.
